title: LAMMPS：溫控自由度與偏置速度稽核
titleEn: LAMMPS: thermostat degrees of freedom and velocity-bias audit
subcategoryTitle: 分子、電子結構與粒子科學計算
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「LAMMPS：溫控自由度與偏置速度稽核」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付速度與動能帳本、自由度扣除表、兩種反例與溫控設定審查紀錄。
summaryEn: Investigate LAMMPS: thermostat degrees of freedom and velocity-bias audit using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a velocity and energy ledger, a degree-of-freedom subtraction table, two diagnostic counterexamples and a thermostat configuration review that distinguishes temperature definition from temperature regulation.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「粒子群與座標盤點」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Inventory particles and coordinates: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 溫度偏高可能是自由度少算，也可能是流場速度未移除；比較去偏置前後動能可區分，不能只調溫控強度。
接受溫度定義須能追溯群組、偏置與約束，並以靜止極限與平移不變性檢查，才進行平衡分布研究。
同一動能卻得到不同溫度，未必是溫控器故障；先確認粒子群、質心速度與約束扣除是否一致。
optionsEn: An inflated temperature can arise from too few degrees of freedom or unremoved streaming motion. Comparing biased and unbiased kinetic energy distinguishes these mechanisms more reliably than retuning thermostat strength.

Accept the temperature definition only after group membership, bias removal and constraints are traceable. Test the stationary limit and invariance to uniform translation before investigating equilibrium distributions.

Two thermostat reports disagree despite identical kinetic energy. Before changing damping parameters, an investigator must reconcile the particle group, removed center-of-mass motion and independent mechanical constraints.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。同一動能卻得到不同溫度，未必是溫控器故障；先確認粒子群、質心速度與約束扣除是否一致。 與本階段判準一起判讀：十二減三為九；不能因為有四粒子就直接使用十二自由度。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Two thermostat reports disagree despite identical kinetic energy. Before changing damping parameters, an investigator must reconcile the particle group, removed center-of-mass motion and independent mechanical constraints. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Twelve minus three gives nine; four particles do not automatically imply twelve active thermal degrees of freedom.
